script: Five goals. *Zero* progress. || 5 or 6 *free* hours a week. || Split 5 ways: one *hour* each. || Pick *one* for 12 weeks. || Side business: your *5* best hours. || Not your ~leftover~ time. || The rest go on *minimum*. || Running: 2 *easy* runs a week. || Fitness *kept*. spoken: [hook] Five goals at once usually means zero progress. || Think about it. With work and everything else, you've got maybe five or six free hours a week. || Split that five ways, and each goal gets about an hour. That's not enough to move any of them. || [turn] So pick one main goal for the next twelve weeks. Just one. || Say it's launching a side business. That goal gets your five best hours every week. || Not whatever leftover time you have at the end of the day. || The other goals don't disappear. They go on the minimum, just enough to keep them alive. || So if you're a runner, that's two easy runs a week. || You keep your fitness, you're just not training for a race right now. || And anything you can't even do the minimum for, park it on a list with a date, like January first, when you'll look at it again. || [land] Because one goal that's actually moving beats five goals that are all stuck. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, || [outro] and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
